title: Comet Heist: Twin-Pulse Vault Run
summary: A symmetrical, all-printed tabletop dexterity game for one or two players. Flick tactile comets through two independently swinging gravity gates, bank from marked rail facets, and land fully inside 2/4/6-point vaults. The Make package contains a 24-piece STEP-first CAD assembly, per-family STLs, complete rules, storage plan, deterministic digital verification, and an explicit 45-degree generated-support plan. Successful printing, support removal, oscillation time, physical fit, impact retention, durability, and human play remain unverified.
